task.name: T1 Classification
task.objective: Classify an incoming VS Code issue by issue type at the Created prediction boundary.

target.normalization: Use the DTM-established normalization of the historical Issue Type:/Type: representations into the four frozen T1 classes. Ambiguous or non-mappable values must not be force-assigned.

description_control.rule: Description may be used only after removing the target-bearing Issue Type:/Type: material used to derive the target.

rules: Preserve the raw source dataset unchanged.
Do not use future information relative to Created.
Do not use Resolved as a predictive feature.
Do not use Resolution as a predictive feature.
Do not use Issue id as a semantic predictive feature.
Do not silently merge VS Code with IT Support.
Do not force ambiguous target values into a class.
Preserve label provenance during target derivation.
Remove target-bearing Description material before using Description as a predictive feature.
Freeze the chronological split before model training.
Establish the baseline before advanced model selection.
